senses.gloss: to mumble, think (cmp. דבב); to be silent. Denom. (דִּימָה,) דָּמוּת.
(denom. of דְּמוּת) to resemble, be like, to imitate.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 29b:7">Ber. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>שתפלתו דוֹמָה עליו וכ׳</he> to whom his prayer appears like a burden.
<cite ref="Taanit 22b:5">Taan. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>אין דורו דומה יפה</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20) his generation was not considered worthy.

B. Kam. 92ᵇ; Yalk. Jud. 67 ובן אדם לדו׳ לו (not ובני) and man associates with his equal. Sifra Sh’mini Par. 10, ch. XII; Ḥull. 76ᵇ הַדּוֹמֶה that which resembles the animal specified in the Bible (species); הד׳ לַדּוֹמֶה what resembles the animal classified with the animal specified in the Bible (genus); a. fr.—אֵינוֹ דוֹמֶה there is no resemblance, you cannot compare.
<cite ref="Yevamot 64a">Yeb. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ ד׳ תפלת … לתפלת וכ׳</he> you cannot compare the prayer of … to the prayer of &c.

<cite ref="Chullin 48b:9">Ḥull. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>זו דוֹמָה לזו</he> these are analogous cases, v. Pi.—(<cite ref="M02911"><he>משל</he></cite>) <he>למה הדבר דומה</he> (abbrev. <he>מלה״ד</he>, <he>לה״ד</he>) (a simile:) to what can this be compared?, a phrase introducing a simile.

senses.gloss: to be compared, to be imagined; to appear in the disguise of; to seem.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 32b:5">Kidd. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>כמה״ש נִדְמוּ לו</he> that they appeared to him as ministering angels; <he>נדמו לו לערביים</he> they appeared to him as if they were Arabs.

Succ. 52ᵃ צדיקים נ׳ להם כהר וכ׳ to the righteous sin will appear like a high mount; a. fr.—נִדְמֶה an animal suspected to be a hybrid or looking like one (cmp. דְּמַאי), esp. a lamb looking like a kid, and vice versa.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 12a:14">Bekh. 12ᵃ</cite> ‘a ewe which gave birth to what looked like a kid’.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 32:2">Lev. R. s. 32</cite> <he>דִּמִּיתִיךָ להם</he> I made thee like them (beasts).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 130b:8">B. Bath. 130ᵇ</cite> <he>ובלבד שלא יְדַמֶּה וכ׳</he> but one must not decide ritual cases by analogy; v.

senses.gloss: to have an opinion without authority to refer to.
units: Gitt. 19ᵃ; 37ᵃ מפני שאנו מְדַמִּין because we have such an opinion.—Part. pass. מְדוּמֶּה, pl. מְדוּמִּין; כמ׳ אני it seems to me, כמ׳ אנו it seems to us &c.
<cite ref="Taanit 23a">Taan. 23ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Ber. II, 5ᵇ bot. <he>כמ׳ הייתי</he> I thought.
